AdapterCapability.description:
Declarative capability contract for a pluggable BMP adapter.

The entrypoint is metadata only until a host explicitly registers the
implementation object.  This keeps a TOML declaration from silently
selecting executable code while still making supported kinds and config
paths inspectable and hashable.
AdapterCapability.title: AdapterCapability

AdapterCapabilityArtifact.description:
Resolved plugin declaration and implementation byte identity.

``source_closure_*`` records the local Python helpers imported by the
entrypoint.  Keeping relative names separate from absolute artifact refs
makes the digest stable across record relocation while still allowing the
verifier to rehash every persisted byte.
AdapterCapabilityArtifact.title: AdapterCapabilityArtifact

ArtifactRef.description: Content-addressed reference to an artifact stored outside the manifest.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

AssemblySidecarRef.description:
Opaque reference to the assembly sidecar produced by ``magenta_hcp``.

BMP records path and digest for provenance but does not interpret contents.
AssemblySidecarRef.title: AssemblySidecarRef

AssemblySubjectArtifact.description: Pinned harness whose assembly evidence remains opaque to BMP core.
AssemblySubjectArtifact.title: AssemblySubjectArtifact

Budget.description: Hard limits for a run; absent fields mean that limit is unspecified.
Budget.title: Budget

ClaimDesign.description: Orthogonal research subject, registered intervention, and purpose.
ClaimDesign.title: ClaimDesign

ComparisonKind.description: The four semantic subjects that BMP is allowed to compare.
ComparisonKind.title: ComparisonKind

ConfigurationArtifact.description:
Resolved configuration tree bound to every profile/source byte.

``json_schema`` is the merged, replayable schema tree and ``ownership``
records which adapter contributed each resolved dotted path. ``adapter``
remains a compatibility summary (``composite`` when several namespaces
participate).
ConfigurationArtifact.title: ConfigurationArtifact

ConfigurationCompositionStep.description:
One deterministic layer used to produce a resolved configuration.

Source refs alone prove that the input bytes still exist, but do not prove
how profiles, external files, and inline overlays were ordered.  The
compiler records this small, JSON-only recipe so a standalone verifier can
replay the composition without importing adapter code.
ConfigurationCompositionStep.title: ConfigurationCompositionStep

CredentialRef.description: Identity-bearing credential digest; secret values are never serialized.
CredentialRef.title: CredentialRef

CustomBenchmarkArtifact.description: Resolved form of a benchmark implemented by an external adapter.
CustomBenchmarkArtifact.title: CustomBenchmarkArtifact

DatasetArtifact.description: Digest-bound dataset declaration carried by a resolved manifest.
DatasetArtifact.title: DatasetArtifact

EnvironmentSpec.description: Reproducible environment requirements; interpreter pin is mandatory.
EnvironmentSpec.title: EnvironmentSpec

EvaluatorMetricBinding.description: Maps one adapter-native output key onto a registered metric identity.
EvaluatorMetricBinding.title: EvaluatorMetricBinding

EvaluatorSpec.description: TOML-registered evaluator and its emitted metric bindings.
EvaluatorSpec.title: EvaluatorSpec

EvolutionMethodArtifact.description: Resolved evolver declaration bound to the full configuration identity.
EvolutionMethodArtifact.title: EvolutionMethodArtifact

EvolutionSelectionSpec.description:
Registered parent-selection semantics for an evolution method.

The registry owns the selector and every parameter that can change its
realized choice. Runtime receipts add the concrete candidate population
and RNG state; they must not invent a selector that is absent here.
EvolutionSelectionSpec.title: EvolutionSelectionSpec

EvolutionSurfacePolicy.description:
Explicit mutation boundary for evolution and meta-evolution.

Paths use a semantic namespace rather than host filesystem paths. A change
is authorized only when it is under an editable root and under no protected
root. Evaluation authority is always protected so a method cannot improve
its own score by rewriting the measurement contract.
EvolutionSurfacePolicy.title: EvolutionSurfacePolicy

ExperimentRegimeKind.description: Research setting orthogonal to the four comparison subjects.
ExperimentRegimeKind.title: ExperimentRegimeKind

ExperimentRegimeSpec.description:
TOML authority for multi-stage research settings.

The DAG expresses generalization, transfer, continual learning, curriculum,
online adaptation, robustness, evolution, and meta-evolution without
introducing another semantic comparison kind.
ExperimentRegimeSpec.title: ExperimentRegimeSpec

ExperimentStageSpec.description: One node in a pre-registered experiment-stage DAG.
ExperimentStageSpec.title: ExperimentStageSpec

FactorCategory.description: Closed semantic classes for registered intervention/nuisance factors.
FactorCategory.title: FactorCategory

FactorLevel.description: One named, TOML-registered value in a factor domain.
FactorLevel.title: FactorLevel

FactorSpec.description:
Single source of truth for a sweep axis and its isolation contract.

A factor declaration replaces the former four-way repetition across
``ClaimScope``, ``factor_path``, ``allowed_diff`` and ``vary``.  The
compiler derives every arm and allowed resolved diff from this object.
FactorSpec.title: FactorSpec

MetaEvolutionMethodArtifact.description: Resolved meta-evolver bound to its parent method and configuration.
MetaEvolutionMethodArtifact.title: MetaEvolutionMethodArtifact

MetricFormulaParameters.description: Typed parameters whose meaning is owned by ``MetricFormula``.
MetricFormulaParameters.title: MetricFormulaParameters

MetricGroupKey.description:
Identity keys available to an intermediate metric reduction.

A reducer first operates inside every declared group and the resulting
group values are macro-averaged unless the formula says otherwise.  The
task key is available from every schedule receipt; stage/domain/generation
keys require their corresponding typed receipt and therefore fail closed
when selected on a plain single-stage schedule.
MetricGroupKey.title: MetricGroupKey

MetricSamplingSpec.description: Sampling assumptions required by a repeated-rollout estimand.
MetricSamplingSpec.title: MetricSamplingSpec

MetricSpec.description:
Versioned metric semantics selected only through a TOML registry.

The formula, population, failure handling, unit, and dependency identities
are all part of the metric digest. This prevents a familiar display name
such as ``pass@1`` from silently changing denominator or exception policy.
MetricSpec.title: MetricSpec

ProtocolSpec.description: Execution schedule defaults resolved before local execution overrides.
ProtocolSpec.title: ProtocolSpec

ProviderBinding.description: Resolved provider, transport, model, and credential identity.
ProviderBinding.title: ProviderBinding

ResolvedExecutionSpec.description:
Execution contract with registry references inlined.

``provider_binding`` is absent for the closed ``none/*`` execution modes.
It is optional for an exploratory real-model run so missing provider
identity can be recorded explicitly, but a positive runtime result requires
it plus a matching :class:`ModelActivationReceipt`.
ResolvedExecutionSpec.title: ResolvedExecutionSpec

ScoringKind.title: ScoringKind

StatisticalAnalysisPlan.description:
Pre-registered paired analysis contract carried by every arm.

``paired_unit`` names the complete factor key used to match one control
observation with one treatment observation. ``case_id`` is the runtime
case identity; all other names refer to ``ResolvedManifestMetadata.factors``.
The implementation is intentionally small and versioned so a standalone
verifier can reproduce the exact variance and interval calculation.
StatisticalAnalysisPlan.title: StatisticalAnalysisPlan
